title: Billing Reference: Term Proration on a Transferred Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection Contract
content:
**Clause.** On a home-sale transfer of a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, a term-proration share applies by multiplication to the open benefit carried to the buyer. The share is set by the whole calendar months of the coverage term elapsed from the coverage start to the closing date on the transfer request, compared with the term's months (the tier's labor coverage years times twelve):

| Months elapsed | Term-proration share |
|---|---|
| more than three quarters of the term's months | the months still to run divided by the term's months |
| more than half, but no more than three quarters, of the term's months | one less the months elapsed beyond the midpoint divided by the term's months |
| half of the term's months or less | one |

The months still to run are the term's months less the months elapsed; the months beyond the midpoint are the months elapsed less half the term's months.

**Worked figures (hypothetical, a 12-year term of 144 months: half is 72, three quarters is 108).**

| Months elapsed | Band | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 72 | half or less | 1 |
| 80 | above half, not above three quarters | one less 8 divided by 144, about 0.9444 |
| 108 | above half, not above three quarters | one less 36 divided by 144, that is 0.75 |
| 109 | above three quarters | 35 divided by 144, about 0.2431 |

For a 10-year term of 120 months the midpoint is 60 and three quarters is 90: 75 months elapsed gives one less 15 divided by 120, that is 0.875.
